notes: §1985:XIII.2.3.4 GR3: 'The ASSIGN clause specifies the association of the report file referenced by file-name-1 to a storage medium referenced by implementor-name-1 or literal-1.' AssignTargetRule.Resolve reads the TO list (one name, or a device class plus a name, per docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-71) into the host file the runtime FileConnector/FileRegistry opens, and the 2002 data-name association (ASSIGN USING) is gated at 85 by VersionConformancePass.VisitAssignClause (COBOL0900). Probes at --std 85 (report file, FILE STATUS FS): ASSIGN TO ASGNIMP (implementor-name) writes asgnimp.txt, ASSIGN TO "lit.txt" writes lit.txt, ASSIGN TO PRINTER "pr.txt" writes pr.txt, each holding HELLO with OPEN/CLOSE 00; (c) ASSIGN USING WSNAME COBOL0900; ASSIGN TO WSNAME where WSNAME is a WORKING-STORAGE item is read as implementor-name-1, not as the item's content (writes wsname.txt), as the 1985 text requires; (b) ASSIGN TO "" COBOL2645 plus COBOL0900; no ASSIGN at all COBOL5701; (e) an unopenable path gives OPEN status 30 (probe o9). The witness (report file and a plain file assigned to one literal reach one medium: HELLO read back) passes.

next.reason: 1985: "to a storage medium reference by implementor-name-1 or literal-1."; 2023: "identified by device-name-1, literal-1, or the content of the data item referenced by data-name-1". 2023 keeps association by device-name/literal but adds a case: association by data-name-1 contents (USING), at OPEN time, with OPEN unsuccessful on a mismatch.
